jobs.description: IT Jobs, CITAM Jobs. The Head of ICT leads ICT strategy, cybersecurity, enterprise systems, cloud/infrastructure, data governance, and digital transformation, requiring a born-again Christian with a Computer Science/IT/Software Engineering degree, relevant certifications, and 10+ years’ ICT experience (5+ in senior leadership). responsibilities: ICT Strategy and Digital Transformation: Lead the development, implementation and continual review of CITAM’s ICT strategy and digital transformation roadmap, aligned with the ministry’s mission, strategic objectives and future growth.

ICT Operating Model and Portfolio Governance: Own the ICT operating model and technology portfolio by translating approved strategy into annual plans, priorities, roadmaps and investment cases; manage dependencies, resources, risks, benefits and value-realisation reporting.

ICT Infrastructure, Cloud and Enterprise Platforms: Provide strategic oversight of ICT infrastructure, networks, systems administration, databases, Microsoft 365, cloud platforms, collaboration services and mission-critical enterprise applications, ensuring security, availability, scalability and performance.

jobs.title: Senior Security Solution Architect – Enterprise Business Job Airtel
jobs.description: Home»Jobs»IT Jobs In Kenya»Senior Security Solution Architect – Enterprise Business Job Airtel
responsibilities: Customer advisory and technical sales support. Lead discovery workshops, presentations, demonstrations and proofs of concept. Qualify customer requirements and support technical proposals. For each opportunity, establish an agreed scope covering assets, applications, sites, users, traffic, log volumes, retention, integrations and customer dependencies; maintain a requirements and compliance matrix with evidence, assumptions and exceptions.

Security architecture and assurance. Set solution direction and review service and supplier security. Lead threat modelling and close design gaps. Produce high-level and low-level designs covering trust boundaries, identity, data flows, resilience, capacity and integration. Address DDoS, WAF, API and bot protection, endpoint, email, DLP, IAM/PAM, network segmentation, vulnerability management and cloud or container controls using domain specialists where required.

Bid costing and commercial feasibility. Own technical inputs to RFP/RFI responses, statements of work, bills of materials and quantities, sizing and licensing. Validate SKUs, subscription periods, renewals, support entitlements and OEM authorisations. Work with finance and sales on implementation effort, staffing, total cost of ownership and margins; document exclusions, acceptance criteria and change controls before commitments are made.

Manage security service design. Develop MSSP offerings and explain their business value. Design SOC/MDR delivery for on-premises, cloud and hybrid environments, including tenant isolation, SIEM ingestion, detection engineering, SOAR, threat intelligence and incident response. Specify 24×7 coverage, L1/L2/L3 responsibilities, escalation, reporting and measurable SLAs; design migration and parallel monitoring to preserve log, alert, case and detection continuity.

Delivery governance and operational handover. Guide implementation and acceptance with project managers, engineers and service owners. Define migration, testing, rollback and disaster recovery plans, then validate performance, failover and protection effectiveness. Ensure approved designs, operating procedures, as-built records and customer training are completed. Resolve architecture escalations and track design defects until delivery teams and customers accept closure.

Portfolio development and partner enablement. Track threat and technology developments and train teams. Build reusable service descriptions, scoping tools, reference designs and proposal assets for Airtel Enterprise Business. Evaluate OEM capabilities, interoperability and supplier dependencies; support reseller and service partner enablement. Assess automation and AI-assisted security with controls for customer data, access and human review, and use delivery lessons to improve offerings.
requirements: 18+ years of relevant network, infrastructure and cybersecurity experience, including substantial responsibility for security architecture, customer solutioning and implementation.

Evidence of having successfully led enterprise security bids and deployments; technical designs, sizing and commercial inputs; customer-facing workshops and PoCs; SOC/MDR or managed security service design; integration and delivery governance across multiple suppliers.

Desirable Experience in African markets, telecommunications, banking or fintech; multi-country engagements; hybrid environments, Kubernetes and virtualised workloads; building services for an MSSP or systems integrator.

jobs.description: Home»Jobs»Director Jobs In Kenya»Director of Data Systems Job Trees for the Future
responsibilities: The Director of Data Systems works in close partnership with MEL, Programs, Carbon, Fundraising, IT, and other TREES teams to understand their operational needs, user workflows, challenges, and priorities. This partnership informs the data systems strategy and roadmap, ensuring that improvements address real business needs and support TREES’ programmatic and organizational goals.

The Director owns TREES’ data systems strategy, technical architecture, and prioritized improvement roadmap, with Salesforce as the core operational platform. The Director translates stakeholder needs into a sequenced plan for improving Salesforce and connected systems, balancing immediate operational priorities with long-term scalability, reliability, maintainability, and cost-effectiveness.

The Director serves as TREES’ senior technical authority for Salesforce architecture and the broader program-focused data systems ecosystem. The role provides hands-on technical leadership through architecture and design decisions, review of technical designs and code, and oversight of system quality. The Director evaluates proposed solutions, challenges unnecessary complexity, and ensures that implementation approaches align with TREES’ data model and technical standards.

The Director shares responsibility for implementation delivery with the Data Systems Senior Manager and external consultants. The Senior Manager manages day-to-day Salesforce administration and assigned enhancements, including requirements follow-up, user acceptance testing, and routine release coordination. The Director leads major projects and complex technical initiatives, owns significant architecture decisions and delivery risks, and holds staff and consultants accountable for quality, maintainability, and delivery.

The Director initially supervises the Data Systems Senior Manager and helps build TREES’ internal data systems capacity and staffing structure as needs evolve. The role reports to the Senior Director of Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning.
requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Data Systems, Business Systems, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
8+ years of progressive experience in Salesforce and business/data systems, including substantial experience with Salesforce architecture, data modeling, configuration, and technical solution design.
Demonstrated experience designing and overseeing Salesforce integrations and cross-platform data flows, including API-based integrations.

Experience leading major Salesforce implementations, system modernization initiatives, and technical roadmaps, including project planning, prioritization, resource allocation, and delivery management.
Experience establishing technical standards and overseeing system architecture, security, testing, documentation, deployment, and change control.
